rationale: Price is at 97.9% of today's range and within 0.19% of the session high after a strong intraday recovery from $57.23 to $62.93, but the stock is extended well above VWAP ($59.47) and the 9-EMA ($60.67), making a long entry at this level a late chase with poor risk/reward. A short is tempting given the negative fundamental backdrop (massive negative FCF, heavy debt load, rising rate sensitivity) and the proximity to today's high acting as resistance, but the momentum on the last 5 candles is clearly bullish with volume support, and fighting that tape near the high without a clear reversal signal is low-probability. The setup lacks a clean mechanical edge in either direction at this moment.
